body:
### Bug type

Behavior bug (incorrect output/state without crash)

### Beta release blocker

No

### Summary

On the operator approval page (`/approve/system-agent:…`, "Operator approval", for `install plugin @openclaw/sms`), the Allow button's label is white on a very light background, so the button reads as empty. It works when clicked ("Approved here — The operation was approved for this request only."), but an owner cannot see what they are about to press.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Have the agent propose a change through the `openclaw` tool; open the `/approve/…` link it relays.
2. Look at the Allow button.

### Expected behavior

The Allow and Deny buttons are legible in both the light and dark themes.

### Actual behavior

The Allow label is white on a near-white background.

### OpenClaw version

`2026.9.1` (commit `ad6fe23`), the official Docker image `ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw:2026.9.1-browser`

### Operating system

the image's Debian, in Docker on an Ubuntu 24.04 host

### Install method

Docker Compose; onboarding by `openclaw onboard --non-interactive`

### Model

`openai/gpt-5.6-sol` through the ChatGPT subscription sign-in

### Provider / routing chain

OpenAI (ChatGPT sign-in) → `openai/gpt-5.6-sol`, no fallbacks configured

### Additional provider/model setup details

none beyond the above

### Logs

```shell

```

### Screenshots, recordings, and evidence

_No response_

### Impact and severity

Cosmetic, but on the one page an owner is asked to make a security decision; an invisible Allow next to a visible Deny reads as a broken page.

### Additional information

Observed on `2026.9.1`, official `-browser` image; the link opened from Telegram in a laptop browser.

Codex review: this still needs some work.

**Summary**
The contrast defect remains in current main, and the linked fix PR closed without merging; this issue still warrants a focused repair.

Reproducibility: Current markup and CSS establish the failure: the light-theme ordinary-button rule overrides the background while the standalone Allow once rule retains white text; no live reproduction was run.

**Root-cause cluster**
Relationship: `canonical`
Canonical: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/149994
Summary: This issue remains the canonical contrast report; its former fix closed unmerged, and merged scope-display work addressed a separate concern.

Members:
- `fixed_by_candidate`: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/150045 - Historical candidate for the same defect, closed without merging after the renderer migration.
- `adjacent_distinct`: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164534 - Merged approval scope display explicitly excluded the contrast repair.

Proposal only: this assessment does not dispatch repair, suppress jobs, mutate sibling items, close, or merge anything.

**Next step**
Fix the Solid approval renderer’s Allow once styling and establish a failing light-theme contrast regression before opening a PR.


<details>
<summary>Review details</summary>

Best possible solution:

Use the shared primary-button variant for Allow once and remove its competing local color rules.

Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue?

Current markup and CSS establish the failure: the light-theme ordinary-button rule overrides the background while the standalone Allow once rule retains white text; no live reproduction was run.

Is this the best way to solve the issue?

Reusing the existing primary variant matches the in-app approval card and avoids another competing color policy.

AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant.

Remaining risk / open question:

- Computed browser contrast and visual appearance were not exercised during this read-only review.

Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [bf9709250b87](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bf9709250b87bec4a26637046096092ee68d3366).

</details>

<summary>Label changes</summary>

Label changes:

- add `clawsweeper:queueable-fix`: Current issue advisory state selects this label.
- add `clawsweeper:fix-shape-clear`: Current issue advisory state selects this label.
- remove `clawsweeper:no-new-fix-pr`: Current issue advisory state no longer selects this label.
- remove `clawsweeper:linked-pr-open`: Current issue advisory state no longer selects this label.

Label justifications:

- `P2`: The unreadable approval label has limited blast radius, and the reported button remains functional.
- `impact:ux-friction`: Operators cannot readily identify the Allow action while reviewing an approval.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Evidence reviewed</summary>

Acceptance criteria:

- Establish a failing light-theme computed-contrast regression on the unchanged base, then verify it passes with the repair.
- pnpm test:ui:e2e ui/src/e2e/approval-page.e2e.test.ts
- pnpm lint:ui:styles
- pnpm check:changed
- git diff --check

What I checked:

- **Current renderer retains the defect:** ApprovalContent renders every decision with btn and its approval-page modifier, without primary for allow-once. ([`ui/src/pages/approval/approval-presentation.tsx:296`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/bf9709250b87bec4a26637046096092ee68d3366/ui/src/pages/approval/approval-presentation.tsx#L296), [bf9709250b87](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bf9709250b87bec4a26637046096092ee68d3366))
- **Conflicting foreground and background owners:** The local allow-once rule sets primary-foreground, while the more specific light-theme selector overrides its background because the button lacks primary or danger; light tokens define white foreground and near-white background. ([`ui/src/styles/approval.css:299`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/bf9709250b87bec4a26637046096092ee68d3366/ui/src/styles/approval.css#L299), [bf9709250b87](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bf9709250b87bec4a26637046096092ee68d3366))
- **Shared light-theme override:** The light-theme ordinary-button selector has greater specificity than the standalone allow-once selector and sets background to var(--bg). ([`ui/src/styles/components.css:1116`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/bf9709250b87bec4a26637046096092ee68d3366/ui/src/styles/components.css#L1116), [bf9709250b87](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bf9709250b87bec4a26637046096092ee68d3366))
- **Existing styling contract:** The adjacent in-app approval card already assigns btn primary to allow-once, providing an existing shared styling owner for the repair. ([`ui/src/components/exec-approval-card-solid.tsx:165`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/bf9709250b87bec4a26637046096092ee68d3366/ui/src/components/exec-approval-card-solid.tsx#L165), [bf9709250b87](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bf9709250b87bec4a26637046096092ee68d3366))
- **Former fix is closed unmerged:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/150045 explicitly targeted this defect, but GitHub reports closed and merged=false; leilei3167 explained that its old approval-page.ts target had been replaced by Solid.
- **Merged adjacent work excludes contrast:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164534 added approval scope display and explicitly states that Allow once contrast was unchanged. ([17b92c6988cd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/17b92c6988cd2ca9effdc8db5443ee9edd1a106c))

</details>
